title: Stone Tools
subtitle: The upgrade that is mostly an attitude
description: Wood is a loan from the greenwood. Stone is the first thing that is
actually yours, taken from the hillside and shaped on the table you
Eight cobblestone carried is enough to make the whole kit: pickaxe,
axe, and the shovel you will pretend you do not need. The quest pays
back the pickaxe, which is how tool chains have worked since before
the first quest book was printed.
